removed.detail: A timezone bug in an integration job produced dates that haven't happened yet.
Records backfilled from an older system, where the timeline runs backwards.
The same person applied to the same job more than once. Only the latest is kept.
The job was deleted after people applied. These are saved separately, not discarded.

quality.name: email is present
quality.why: Coordinators need a way to contact the candidate.
quality.action: Make email required on the Lever application form. Until then these go to a manual worklist.

quality.name: one row per candidate per requisition
quality.action: Handled by the deduplication step in pipeline.py.

quality.name: req_id exists in Workday
quality.why: An application against a missing requisition has no department or hiring manager.
quality.action: Rejected rows are written to rejected_rows.csv for Recruiting to reassign.

quality.name: source is a known channel
quality.why: Attribution reporting only works if the channel names agree.
quality.action: Normalised in the pipeline. Worth fixing the ATS picklist too.

quality.name: applied_at is not in the future
quality.why: Future dates break any report grouped by month.
quality.action: Rejected during cleaning and reported back to whoever owns the integration.

quality.name: offer is within the approved band
quality.why: Offers outside the requisition band need Finance sign-off.
quality.action: Not always a mistake - exceptions get approved. Flagged for review.
